target.notes: 99.84% is a stretch target for stable-prefix, >=200k-token sessions; report honestly when provider/cache state differs. Never game the metric with filler tokens.

workstreams.title: Instruction store and prompt layout v3
deliverables: instruction_blobs and session_instruction_state tables
content-addressed section materialization with sha256 verification
session/context uses the session goal, never the current prompt
run/task section for task-scoped agents
tail/memory section sent after history or as a stable user memory message
context.prompt_prefix carries ordered keys/hashes and prompt_layout=3
session.instructions RPC and vp instructions CLI
tests: byte identity across two calls and two sessions
prompt change appears only as a user message
memory change appears only in the tail
workstreams.acceptance: No prompt/objective/memory bytes in the head stable prefix; ordered hashes stable; legacy sessions decode.

workstreams.title: Append-only conversation and canonical provider serialization
deliverables: canonical message serializer with stable field ordering
message_prefix_hash/previous_message_prefix_hash/append_only per call
cache_break event with bounded reasons
DeepSeek reasoning_content excluded from replayed messages
mid-history tail memory fallback to user message if provider rejects
tests: wiremock body prefix byte identity across turns
DeepSeek usage parsing and reasoning exclusion
workstreams.acceptance: The previous call's canonical messages are an exact prefix of the next call; any break is recorded with a reason.

workstreams.title: Tool bundle partition, freeze, and canonical schema
deliverables: named bundles: leader, coding, research, verification, minimal
task-kind bundle selection, frozen per run
dynamic MCP tools sorted and frozen
canonical tool schema JSON and stable tools_hash
bundle size targets: leader <=48, coding worker <=40, minimal <=12
full-bundle fallback for unknown task kinds
tests: exact bundle sets and role permissions
workstreams.acceptance: A trivial one-file task uses the minimal bundle; the same bundle produces byte-identical tools_hash across sessions.

workstreams.title: Cache epochs, compaction policy, cross-session reuse
deliverables: cache_epoch identity and prompt_prefixes table
cross-session reuse telemetry
window-derived compaction threshold (90% for 1M DeepSeek)
compaction epoch/reset/lost-cache accounting
miss attribution provider_cache_miss vs prefix_changed
explicit warm path remains opt-in
workstreams.acceptance: A new session with the same epoch reports cross-session reuse when the provider reports cache hits; compaction never runs at 75% of a 1M window.

workstreams.title: Telemetry, benchmark, and GUI cache panel
deliverables: per-call input/cache_read/cache_miss/theoretical_max/hit_ratio/miss_reason
session aggregation and bounded call table
vp cache-bench deterministic simulator and live DeepSeek opt-in mode
OpenCode2 baseline extraction script/doc (aggregate only)
Efficiency card and Stage cache panel
cache audit findings for system_changed/append_only/epoch
tests: GUI model label from agent.info (cache-adjacent fix)
workstreams.acceptance: A live DeepSeek long-context benchmark reports provider hit ratio >=99.8%; the GUI shows ratio, miss tokens, epoch, append-only, and top miss reasons.

workstreams.title: Optional cache-loss audit and repair guidance
deliverables: flag system_changed cache breaks and show the first differing section key
suggest stable alternative; never auto-repair
workstreams.acceptance: An operator can see exactly which instruction key caused a cache break.

non_goals: automatic prompt rewriting to recover a cache break

simulator.notes: Deterministic 64-token-block simulator; not provider-reported; prefixes above 400k are rejected to prevent ratio manufacturing.

limitations: cache_epoch proves byte identity, not a provider hit guarantee
first call is uncached and append_only is null
compaction resets the conversation cache generation
no cross-host cache index or automatic warm
